derivation: feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out;
def: something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye

occurrences.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
